content: Pitu tau dipilei la untarakanni baine balu

Attu iatoo tuttuan budami kerangngan to mangngorean. Kendekmi nuku-nuku illalan alla'-alla'na to Yahudi to ma'basa Yunani lako to Yahudi senga' to ma'basa Ibrani annu kaparalluanna baine ballunna tangkaan dipapada baine balu senga'.
Urrempummi to mangngorean inde sapulo dua rasul-e, anna ma'kada lako nakua: “Tae' sipato' ke la ta'mokan umpalanda' battakadanna Puang Allata'alla annu la untarakannimokan baine balu.
Dadi mentu'ko siulu', pilemia' pitu tau illalan alla'-alla'mua' to musangaa' mapia penawa anna to nakuasai Penawa Masero anna keaka'. Annu tau iatoo la kiangka' la untarakanni mentu'na baine balu.
Angki malara kami umpatutui penawa umpalanda' battakadanna Puang Allata'alla anna ma'sambayang.”

Nasituru'imi angganna to ma'rempun, napolalan umpile: Stefanus mesa to matoto' kapangngoreananna anna to nakuasai Penawa Masero, sola Filipus, Prokhorus, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, anna Nikolaus to lu dio mai Antiokhia to tama alukna to Yahudi.
Dibaami lako tingngayona rasul. Saei lako ma'sambayangmi rasul anna umballa'i pala' inde to pitue la umpalako karangan iatoo.
Tuttuan budami tau urrangngi battakadanna Puang Allata'alla anna tuttuan kerangngan to mangngorean dio Yerusalem. Buda duka' imam ummorean Puang Yesus.
Stefanus untarima pa'tamba'na Puang Allata'alla anna kakuasaan napolalan mala umpogau' ma'rupa-rupa tanda anna tanda memangnga-mangnga illalan alla'-alla'na tau kamban.

Sapo' dengan pira-pira tau umbalii napolalan sipekka Stefanus. Tau iatoo sima'sambayang illalan mesa pa'sambayanganna to Yahudi disanga Libertini (kalembasanna: Pa'sambayanganna To Dilappasan dio mai kasabuasan), pa'sambayanganna to lu dio mai Kirene, Aleksandria, Kilikia anna Asia.
Sapo' tae' nabela untalo kada Stefanus annu Penawa Masero umbenganni kakeakasan napolalan manarang mantula'.
Laomi usse'dek pira-pira tau la umpatampoi kasalaan Stefanus kumua: “Mangka kirangngi untelle Musa sola Puang Allata'alla.”
Iamo napolalan kendek ara'na tau kamban sola perepi'na to Yahudi anna to untarru' issinna Sura'na Musa. Umpealaimi Stefanus anna mane baai lako tingngayona pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi.
Pira-pira sa'bi tatongan napopengngolo lako pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi, umpalanda' kasa'bianna nakua: “Inde taue untunai liu Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla anna pepa'guruanna Musa.
Mangka kirangngi nakua: ‘Inde Yesus to Nazaret-e la urroppokan inde Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'allae anna la umbanga' sangka' napa'pa'guruan Musa lako kaleta.’ ”
Angganna to tongkon illalan pa'rempunan iatoo unnenne'i asan Stefanus, naitami lindona susi rupanna malaeka'.
